newPlatforms.notes: Passively verified on 2026-07-19 from NexGen Music's official demo guidelines, upload form, submission terms, contact and release pages. The group accepts unreleased work across Bass Music, House/UK Garage, Downtempo, Future Jazz, Chill-out, Leftfield, Trip-Hop, Pop, R&B, Indie, Rock and other genres, and also considers music-library material. The first-party form requests name, email, info and a file upload up to 300MB. The email route requests the subject 'Demo Submission: (artist name)', real and artist names, links, background and at least four high-quality files or FTP-style download links; streaming-only SoundCloud profiles are rejected. By submitting, the artist must be at least 18 and agrees to broad non-exclusive worldwide royalty-free sublicensable use rights through the website, warranties and indemnity terms. No mandatory fee, login or visible CAPTCHA was observed; hidden upload and submit-time controls were not exercised. Current activity is confirmed by Rob Sparx & Afua's Immunity EP dated 3 July 2026 and Kachina's Zurcon's Prayer EP dated 19 June 2026. No form field, file, link, email, terms acceptance, payment or submission was used.
